My audio sounds unchanged. What should I check?

Make sure the effect is enabled and has settings that change the sound. Click Apply effects, then select Result. A flat equalizer and a full-range trim intentionally preserve the input.

Can I recover a session after reloading?

Sessions are held in browser memory. Download your result before reloading, and keep your original audio file.
